background.title: Background
background.body: I am a full-stack software engineer with a B.S. in Software Engineering from East Carolina University and I am currently pursuing an M.S. in Software Engineering. I build web and mobile applications with a focus on maintainable architecture, API design, testing, and iterative delivery. My recent academic and project work includes software project management, requirements engineering, verification and validation, and software maintenance and evolution. I enjoy turning ambiguous requirements into reliable, user-focused products and collaborating across teams to ship measurable improvements. I am seeking early-career full-stack software engineering roles where I can contribute across the stack and continue growing in modern engineering practices.

heading.title: This is a small collection of various projects I've developed or made significant contributions to...

modal.content_0_desc: Streaming SENG-3000 is a full-stack Django application developed as both a university assignment and a professional portfolio piece. It evolved into a feature-rich movie and TV streaming platform, integrating user account management, advanced database modeling, and cloud-based deployment.
modal.content_0_f1: User Authentication & Profiles: Secure registration, login, and logout using Django's authentication framework with automatic profile creation
modal.content_0_f2: Media Library & Streaming: Robust models for Movies, TV Shows, Seasons, Episodes, Actors with support for uploading and streaming video files
modal.content_0_f3: RESTful API: Extensive API powered by Django REST Framework with ModelViewSets for all core entities
modal.content_0_f4: Database Architecture: Advanced data modeling with Django ORM including 1-to-many and many-to-many relationships
modal.content_0_f5: Front-End & Interaction: Responsive HTML templates with dynamic video carousels and grid listings
modal.content_0_i3: Static/media asset handling for scalable cloud serving
modal.content_1_desc: VampLife is a collaborative, full-stack web application serving as the capstone for an "E-Commerce Development" graduate course. Designed and built as a group project, it demonstrates advanced CRUD capabilities, creative UI development, and robust back-end integrations using modern cloud and database technologies. Delivered under a compressed 48-hour timeline.
modal.content_1_f1: User Experience & Theming: Immersive "vampire sanctuary" UI with interactive home page and team member showcase
modal.content_1_f2: Interactive Quiz & Personalization: "Vampire Test" form with dynamic evaluation logic and personalized scoring
modal.content_1_f3: Results & Data Handling: Secure session and data handling with Redis integration for real-time feedback
modal.content_1_f4: Team & Collaboration: Team landing page highlighting member education, bios, and skill progression
modal.content_1_t1: Backend: Python 3 (Flask framework), Flask-Migrate for DB migrations
modal.content_1_t2: Data & Sessions: Redis (cloud) with advanced error handling and JSON serializations
modal.content_1_t3: Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 5, Jinja2 templating, JavaScript/JQuery
modal.content_1_t4: DevOps/Hosting: Railway.app for cloud deployment; Gunicorn for production WSGI
modal.content_1_i1: Redis cloud for session-aware data storage
modal.content_2_desc: UNIA-ACL is a robust full-stack Django web application built to serve the Universal Negro Improvement Association and African Communities League. The platform advances social justice by providing a centralized portal for outreach, member engagement, events, and organizational growth.
modal.content_2_f1: Public-Facing Website: Mission, history, and leadership pages with dynamic events calendar and e-commerce store for merchandise
modal.content_2_f2: Member Dashboard: Role-specific dashboards with secure private calendar, peer-to-peer messaging, virtual conference spaces, and digital library
modal.content_2_f3: Marketplace & Production Operations: Phased deployment strategy with Stripe Connect integration, automated cleanup jobs, and advanced monitoring
modal.content_2_f4: Real-time Notifications: WebSocket-based messaging and real-time notifications for events and organizational updates
modal.content_2_t1: Backend: Django 5+, Django REST Framework, Celery for task processing
modal.content_2_t4: Real-time: Django Channels and WebSockets for messaging/notifications
modal.content_2_t5: E-commerce/Payments: Stripe API (including Stripe Connect for sellers)
modal.content_2_t6: Assets & CDN: Cloudflare for static/doc hosting
modal.content_2_t7: DevOps: Docker, Railway, Redis for caching and channel layers
modal.content_2_t8: Other: Prometheus for monitoring; Locust for load testing
modal.content_2_i1: Stripe: Secure payments, subscriptions, and marketplace payouts
modal.content_2_i2: Cloudflare: Static asset delivery and image hosting
modal.content_2_i3: Celery: Background jobs for cleanup, notifications, and rate-limited tasks
modal.content_2_i4: Django Channels: Real-time WebSocket messaging and notifications
modal.content_3_desc: Cesium Globe App is a browser-based interactive 3D map that visualizes county-level U.S. unemployment data. Leveraging CesiumJS, this project merges raw labor statistics with geospatial boundaries to provide an engaging, color-coded (choropleth) globe where users gain a spatial and temporal perspective on employment trends nationwide.
modal.content_3_f1: Data Transformation & Integration: Automated CSV data ingestion from Bureau of Labor Statistics with conversion to optimized JSON format
modal.content_3_f2: Dynamic Choropleth Visualization: 3D globe rendering with counties shaded by unemployment rate and state extrusion on selection
modal.content_3_f3: User Interaction & Exploration: Intuitive globe navigation (zoom, rotate, pan) with year/time selector for trend comparison
modal.content_3_f4: Performance & Data Handling: Efficient loading of high-resolution geospatial data with prefetching and caching mechanisms
modal.content_3_t1: Frontend: HTML, JavaScript (CesiumJS, D3.js for data handling and visualization)
modal.content_3_t2: Data Processing: Client-side scripts converting CSV to JSON with geospatial enrichment
modal.content_3_t3: Mapping Engine: CesiumJS for real-time 3D globe rendering
modal.content_3_i1: Bureau of Labor Statistics: Official U.S. unemployment data source
modal.content_3_i2: U.S. Census Bureau/GeoJSON: Authoritative county-level boundary data
modal.content_4_desc: SD-Firm Django is a full-service software development platform designed to deliver scalable web and mobile solutions for entrepreneurs, startups, and established organizations. Built with a mission to empower, educate, and uplift—with special emphasis on Black-owned enterprises—the platform blends innovation and representation to produce digital experiences that authentically reflect each business's story and values.
modal.content_4_f1: Strategy & Requirements Planning: Guided requirement elicitation, UML diagramming, and technical documentation
modal.content_4_f2: Service & Project Management: Manage services/products, pricing, clients, and projects with flexible lifecycle support (scrum, agile, waterfall)
modal.content_4_f3: Client Engagement: Lead capture, onboarding workflows, consultation requests, and automated communications
modal.content_4_f4: Web & Mobile Development: Custom production-ready web applications and cross-platform mobile prototyping
modal.content_4_f5: AI & Data Science Solutions: Discovery workflows for AI applications with ethical integration and business process automation

modal.content_4_t2: Frontend: HTML5, Bootstrap, custom CSS, JavaScript interactivity
modal.content_4_t4: AI Integration: OpenAI for project generation and AI agent components
modal.content_4_i2: Stripe for online payments and service billing

Developed as a collaborative course project to enhance team management, communication, and rapid problem-solving skills while gaining experience in deploying production-ready software.

This repository tokenizes software review data, removes stopwords, lemmatizes, and generates N-grams using NLTK, pandas, and scikit-learn for an NSF REU AI research internship. Results influenced the final academic research poster.

modal.content_7_f2: Requirements elicitation and analysis workflow design

modal.content_8_desc: KD-Safety is a full-stack Django web application that streamlines corporate self-defense and safety training programs. The platform bridges business development, customer management, and training operations into a unified system, presenting safety-driven training for organizations with clean, responsive interface design.

modal.content_8_t4: CRM: Zoho OAuth integration with automatic lead syncing

card.description_1: This project began as a RestAPI endpoint assignment and evolved into a comprehensive portfolio piece. It’s progressively becoming a fully functional movie and TV streaming website with user authentication, hosted on a live Linode server with a cloud-based PostgreSQL database. The project demonstrates strong web development and database integration skills. It also incorporates a responsive interface and optimized streaming workflows to deliver seamless playback across devices.
card.description_2: An "E-Commerce Development" graduate course group website designed to display skills gained using C.R.U.D., HTML, JQuery, and pre-set requirements/specifications. Utilizing Django for backend, Docker for containerization, Railway for web hosting and Redis cloud database, lastly, Bootstrap for frontend UI development. This was meant to be a group project but other members didn't contribute, leading me to build it myself, within 48hrs.
card.description_3: The UNIA (Universal Negro Improvement Association) project is a voluntary initiative aimed at promoting equality and social justice through a fully-featured organization website. The codebase is continuously evolving, with ongoing improvements and new features added based on community feedback and member contributions.
card.description_4: An interactive CesiumJS globe visualizing U.S. county‐level unemployment: CSV data is converted to JSON, merged with GeoJSON boundaries, and rendered as a dynamic choropleth. Counties shade by unemployment rate, states extrude on selection, and users toggle color‐blind–safe palettes and layers demonstrating real-world data integration in WebGL.
card.description_5: A simple software development firm webpage. It provides important information about the company's engineering and consulting services, including a detailed price page, and for easy interaction, a contact page. It also features a portfolio section showcasing past projects and client success stories to highlight the firm’s expertise.
card.description_6: A "Software Project Management" group website designed to implement AGILE practices. Utilizing Django for backend, Railway for PSQL cloud database, and Bootstrap for frontend. With an emphasis towards enhancing team management, communication, and rapid problem-solving skills; gaining experience in deploying production-ready software.
card.description_7: A collection of Python scripts to be used for N-gram analysis of software reviews. This repository tokenizes software review data, removes stopwords, lemmatizes, and generates N-grams using NLTK, pandas, and scikit-learn for an NSF REU AI research internship. It also processes review date data. Before running, check the script's directory for data files. The final results influenced the academic poster below.
card.description_8: ECU was interested in conducting research on all the Software Engineering Graduate Degree programs within the nation. The purpose for the research is to use data science analysis techniques to make comparisons between ECU's program and other competing universities for ECU's program improvement. I was given the opportunity to work on this project, wheras I elicited the requirements and implemented them.
card.description_9: KD-Safety is a corporate Krav Maga training platform focused on presenting safety-driven training programs for organizations, with a clean structure for exploring curriculum details and program information.

courses.title: Engineering Related Courses & Certifications
courses.note: Note: G represents graduate-level courses. Enrolled in the M.S. Software Engineering program or consent of instructor.

assistant_instructor.summary: ECU's STEM Mavericks Camp was a weeklong dive into circuits, robotics and coding for high schoolers from underrepresented and military families. Each student got their own Raspberry Pi, hooked up sensors and wrote Python scripts to build fun projects like sequenced LED traffic lights, then showed off their creations at the end of the week.
assistant_instructor.b1: Mentored and supported 62 high school students from economically stressed Tier 1 counties and military-dependent families in three intensive one-week STEM sessions.
assistant_instructor.b2: Designed and delivered hands-on labs using Raspberry Pi, electronic sensors, and Python to teach fundamentals of signal flow, circuitry, and coding.
assistant_instructor.b3: Guided students through building and programming LED traffic signal circuits, troubleshooting hardware/software issues, and reinforcing debugging skills.
assistant_instructor.b4: Facilitated student presentations for parents and camp leadership, coaching effective communication of technical concepts and project outcomes.
assistant_instructor.b5: Collaborated with ECU faculty and DoD CDAO representatives to expose underrepresented youth to defense-relevant technologies and career pathways.
assistant_instructor.cta: Learn more about the STEM Mavericks Camp

self_help_research_assistant.summary: ECU is conducting research on Software Engineering graduate degree programs nationwide. The purpose is to use data science analysis techniques to compare ECU's program with competing universities and support program improvement.
self_help_research_assistant.b1: Developed a research plan to systematically assess national graduate programs in Software Engineering.
self_help_research_assistant.b2: Documented the research process and maintained effective communication with program administrators, ensuring transparency and alignment.
self_help_research_assistant.b3: Applied machine learning algorithms to analyze the data, creating visual outputs that enabled insightful conclusions and strategic recommendations.

ml_research_intern.summary: The National Science Foundation's (NSF) Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU) program provides undergraduate students with hands-on, research-based experiences across scientific and engineering disciplines. The program introduces students to academic research and encourages graduate study or R&D careers. It also builds core AI/ML skills, promotes diversity in research, and tackles current challenges through innovative interdisciplinary projects.
ml_research_intern.b1: Conducted comprehensive research on No-Code Software Development, analyzing over 50 scholarly papers to identify key challenges and emerging opportunities.
ml_research_intern.b2: Enhanced technical proficiency in Overleaf and LaTeX, and mastered Axiom for efficient data scraping, automating extraction of insights from over 2,000 software reviews.
ml_research_intern.b3: Used Python and Jupyter Notebook alongside IBM's AutoAI for advanced data analysis, uncovering trends and patterns in software development practices and user experiences.
ml_research_intern.b4: Strengthened public speaking and presentation skills through weekly updates and a capstone symposium presentation, communicating complex findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

This self-paced course, ideal for those new to programming, offers a flexible learning path complemented by a certificate of completion from Microsoft.
course_desc.28: Aimed at introducing Python programming in the context of data science. It focuses on fundamental Python programming techniques and concepts, including data structures, loops, and Python libraries, essential for data analysis and visualization. The course is designed for beginners and combines theoretical knowledge with practical exercises, making it ideal for those looking to apply Python skills in data science projects.

It covers the fundamentals of building web applications, including database models, the Django template system, forms, and user authentication. Designed for those with basic programming knowledge, this course provides practical skills and insights into developing robust web applications efficiently using Django.
